approvers: Bank, tax adviser, notary, my wife
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. My bank, tax adviser and notary would laugh at it, and I would be left with 30% of the price owed by a company nobody can check.
objection: Belize holding, no money committed, no references. 30% over three years from a company like that could end up worth nothing, and I would have handed over my staff and my name.
instead: Keep looking for a proper buyer through my adviser, the Handwerkskammer or nexxt-change, at around 375,000 euro, or a management buyer or trade buyer I can check.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds already in a German bank or escrow, a German or EU entity with a named, checkable owner, and the full price paid in cash at closing or secured by a bank guarantee.
